answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. The practical consequence is a steady economy where reputation is earned slowly, spent carefully, and never inflated by a sudden influx of cheap accounts.. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. Consider a onyx as the anchor of the cost.
